name: Kolkheti National Park
story: Kolkheti National Park covers an area of 28,940 hectares in western Georgia. Established between 1998 and 1999, it lies on a coastal plain on the Black Sea and features wetlands and forests.
matters: The park protects unique forests and wetlands with high numbers of threatened species and is part of the Colchic Rainforests and Wetlands UNESCO World Heritage site.
